WITH filtered_executions AS (
  SELECT o.orderflow, oe.fillcount
  FROM orders o
  INNER JOIN orderexecutions oe ON o.recordvault = oe.ordersmark
  WHERE oe.fillcount IS NOT NULL AND oe.fillcount > 0
),
status_stats AS (
  SELECT orderflow, AVG(fillcount) as avg_fillcount, COUNT(*) as exec_count
  FROM filtered_executions
  GROUP BY orderflow
),
total_executions AS (
  SELECT SUM(exec_count) as total_count FROM status_stats
)
SELECT s.orderflow, s.avg_fillcount, s.exec_count, CAST(s.exec_count AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / CAST(t.total_count AS DOUBLE PRECISION) as fraction_of_total
FROM status_stats s
CROSS JOIN total_executions t
ORDER BY s.orderflow;

assumptions.assumption: "The number of executions" refers to the count of executions with fillcount > 0 and not NULL—those contributing to the average—not all executions for that status. The phrase "so they are left out" applies to both the average calculation and the count, meaning zero and NULL fills are excluded from all metrics.

alternatives.interpretation: "The number of executions" refers to all executions for each status (including those with fillcount = 0 or NULL), while the average is still calculated only from non-zero, non-NULL fills. The fraction would be (all executions for status) / (total all executions across statuses).
alternatives.sql:
WITH all_executions_per_status AS (
  SELECT o.orderflow, COUNT(*) as exec_count
  FROM orders o
  INNER JOIN orderexecutions oe ON o.recordvault = oe.ordersmark
  GROUP BY o.orderflow
),
filtered_for_avg AS (
  SELECT o.orderflow, AVG(oe.fillcount) as avg_fillcount
  FROM orders o
  INNER JOIN orderexecutions oe ON o.recordvault = oe.ordersmark
  WHERE oe.fillcount IS NOT NULL AND oe.fillcount > 0
  GROUP BY o.orderflow
),
total_all_executions AS (
  SELECT SUM(exec_count) as total_count FROM all_executions_per_status
)
SELECT a.orderflow, f.avg_fillcount, a.exec_count, CAST(a.exec_count AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / CAST(t.total_count AS DOUBLE PRECISION) as fraction_of_total
FROM all_executions_per_status a
LEFT JOIN filtered_for_avg f ON a.orderflow = f.orderflow
CROSS JOIN total_all_executions t
ORDER BY a.orderflow;
